column1: They need some little girl like I need hard lessons learned.
When they pay me no mind
Unaware of where it is I go, or where I'm landing
I go out in the woods
Crushing eggs as loud as we can
It's WAR, YOU'RE NOT MY FAMILY.
How I wish I was like the king
Where poison wouldn't mean a thing.
IF ALL OF THE SPIRITS PAST
WOULD COME TO ME, MAKE ME WISE, CLOAK ME FROM THEIR DRUNKEN EYES
If faith would lift me up
I bet he come to take me home
But if poison wants to slip again
So help me, God, I will kill him.
